entries.title: Deuteronomy 34:1
segments: And Moses went up from the plains of Moab to the mountain of Nebo, to the top of Pisgah that [is] opposite Jericho. And the LORD showed him all the land of Gilead, to Dan,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 34:2
segments: and all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, to the furthest sea,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 34:3
segments: and the south, and the plain of the valley of Jericho, the city of palm trees, to Zoar.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 34:4
segments: And the LORD said to him, This [is] the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, I will give it to your seed. I have caused you to see it with your eyes, but you shall not go over there.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 34:5
segments: And Moses the servant of the LORD died there in the land of Moab, according to the word of the LORD.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 34:6
segments: And He buried him in a valley in the land of Moab, opposite Beth-peor. But no man knows of his grave this day.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 34:7
segments: And Moses [was] a hundred and twenty years old when he died. His eye was not dim, nor had he lost any of his natural strength.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 34:8
segments: And the sons of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days. And the days of weeping [and] mourning for Moses were ended.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 34:9
segments: And Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom, for Moses had laid his hands on him. And the sons of Israel listened to him, and did as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 34:10
segments: And never since has a prophet like Moses arisen in Israel, whom the LORD knew face to face,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 34:11
segments: in all the signs and the wonders which the LORD sent him to do in the land of Egypt, to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 34:12
segments: and in all that mighty hand, and in all the great terror which Moses showed in the eyes of all Israel.
